name: Tian An China Investments Company Limited
summary: Tian An China Investments Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in property development and investment services in the People's Republic of China, Hong Kong, the United Kingdom, and Australia. It operates through Property Development, Property Investment, Healthcare, and Other Operations segments. The company invests in and develops residential, office, and commercial properties; manages properties; and invests in and operates hospitals, eldercare, and health-related businesses.
